test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Acumen
solution: The correct answer is: **Stupidity**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Acumen **means the ability to make good judgments and quick decisions. (अच्छे निर्णय और त्वरित निर्णय लेने की क्षमता) • **For example-** *He will need all his political acumen in these negotiations.* • **Stupidity **means the opposite of acumen, which is the lack of intelligence or good judgment. (बुद्धि या अच्छे निर्णय की कमी) • **For example- ***Her answer showed the most incredible stupidity.* • Hence, it is clear that the most appropriate **antonym **of 'Acumen' is 'Stupidity.' Therefore, the correct answer is option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Good decision** is a synonym for acumen. (अच्छा निर्णय) • **Happiness **is not related to acumen as it refers to a state of being happy or joyful. (खुश या आनंदित होने की अवस्था या भाव) • **Anger **is also not related to acumen as it refers to a strong feeling of annoyance, displeasure, or hostility towards someone or something. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु के प्रति झुंझलाहट, अप्रसन्नता या शत्रुता की प्रबल भावना) 63:T8eb, The correct answer is: **"Good luck."**
